title: Breaking the Assumptions: Auditing Input-Side Jailbreak Defenses Against Semantic Attacks
abstract: arXiv:2608.21895v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Locally deployed Large Language Models (LLMs) via inference engines such as Ollama run without the moderation and abuse detection present in API-served models. Therefore, the safety of LLMs depends on the defense mechanisms used, and their effectiveness depends on the assumptions on which they were designed. This paper does an audit of defense mechanisms under jailbreak attacks on locally deployed models. Some defenses provide formal guarantees (SmoothLLM, Erase-and-Check, Sequential Monitors), while others rely on empirical detection results (Semantic Smoothing, Self-Denoised Smoothing, Perplexity Filtering). Instead of merely observing that defenses fail, we trace each failure back to the specific assumption: for every defense, we extract the condition it relies on, derive the empirical pattern a violation should produce, and test that prediction on six open-weight models (14B to 35B parameters) with a corpus of 100 jailbreak prompts

translated_title: 打破假设：审计输入侧越狱防御措施对抗语义攻击的有效性
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21895v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：通过诸如Ollama等推理引擎本地部署的大型语言模型（LLMs）运行时，缺少API服务模型中的内容审核和滥用检测。因此，LLM的安全性取决于所使用的防御机制，而这些机制的有效性又依赖于它们设计时所依据的假设。本文对本地部署模型在越狱攻击下的防御机制进行了审计。一些防御措施提供了形式化保证（如SmoothLLM、Erase-and-Check、序列监控器），而其他则依赖于经验检测结果（如语义平滑、自去噪平滑、困惑度过滤）。我们不仅观察防御失败的现象，还将每次失败追溯到具体假设：对于每种防御，我们提取其依赖的条件，推导出违反该条件时应产生的经验模式，并在六个开放权重模型（参数规模14B至35B）上使用100个越狱提示语料库测试这些预测。
tldr: 本文系统审计了本地部署LLM的输入侧越狱防御措施，将每种防御的失败追溯到其设计假设的违反，并通过实验验证了这些违反模式。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically audits input-side jailbreak defenses for locally deployed LLMs, tracing each defense's failure to violations of its design assumptions and empirically validating these violation patterns.
